fields.description: AI service that processes the texts. OpenAI-compatible covers most other platforms, such as Mistral, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, LM Studio or vLLM.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: Address of the chat completions API without /chat/completions, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama. Leave empty for the provider's default.
fields.label: Base URL
API Key
fields.description: Not needed for Ollama and many local servers.
Model name of the provider, e.g. claude-haiku-5-5 for Anthropic or llama3.2 for Ollama.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: How much the model reasons before answering. Low is fastest and cheapest. Leave empty for models without effort support.
fields.label: Effort

fields.description: Instructions sent to the model with every request. Leave empty to restore the default.
fields.label: System Prompt

fields.description: Instructions for writing out notes. Leave empty to restore the default.
fields.label: Write-out Prompt

fields.description: The written-out text should have at least about this many times the words of the notes.
fields.label: Minimum Expansion Factor

fields.description: The written-out text should have at most about this many times the words of the notes.
fields.label: Maximum Expansion Factor

fields.description: Target languages offered by the translate button. Leave empty to hide the button.
fields.label: Translation Languages

fields.description: Records token usage per user, not only in total. Before enabling it, check the law that applies in your country, for example on data protection and on co-determination by employee representatives.
fields.label: Track Usage per User

fields.description: Used to estimate costs. The default is the price of claude-haiku-5-5.
fields.label: Input Price per Million Tokens (USD)

fields.description: Used to estimate costs. The default is the price of claude-haiku-5-5.
fields.label: Output Price per Million Tokens (USD)
